info.name: MaskGuard · Smart Data Masking
info.description: Role-based masking, end to end: same query as four roles, policy explanations, 25 negative and security regressions, audit evidence, and an integrity check before and after. Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or `newman run`). Uses synthetic demo identities only.

item.name: Verify source tables before the experiment (auditor)

exec: pm.test('role admin, nothing masked', () => { pm.expect(r.role).to.eql('admin'); pm.expect(r.masked).to.eql([]); });
const r = pm.response.json(); const ssn = pm.collectionVariables.get('adminSsn');
pm.test('SSN keeps only the last 4', () => pm.expect(r.rows[0][2]).to.eql('XXX-XX-' + ssn.slice(-4)));
pm.test('no raw SSN in the body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('adminSsn')));

item.name: Auditor: no raw PII at all
Cross-role comparison (demo identities, one audited query each)

exec: pm.test('admin real, support partial, analyst token', () => { pm.expect(r.admin.rows[0][2]).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('adminSsn')); pm.expect(r.support.rows[0][2]).to.match(/^XXX-XX-/); pm.expect(r.analyst.rows[0][2]).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{16}$/); });
pm.test('three distinct request ids', () => pm.expect(new Set([r.admin.request_id, r.support.request_id, r.analyst.request_id]).size).to.eql(3));

item.name: Query builder: support sees card masks and only active accounts

exec: pm.test('cards masked with X', () => r.rows.forEach(x => pm.expect(x[0]).to.include('X')));
pm.test('row filter: no frozen accounts', () => r.rows.forEach(x => pm.expect(x[1]).to.eql('active')));

item.name: Analyst aggregate: noisy AVG with privacy budget

exec: pm.test('ε charged and budget reported', () => { pm.expect(r.dp.epsilon).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(r.dp.remaining).to.be.below(10); });

item.name: Find the support query by request id

exec: pm.test('every table MATCH', () => r.tables.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.status, t.table).to.eql('MATCH')));
